description: Implementation of TensorBase class methods for tensor operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including tensor manipulation, invariants enforcement, and debugging functions.

classes.name: TensorBase
classes.description: Represents the base tensor class with methods for tensor manipulation, introspection, and autograd hooks.

methods.name: get_tensor_base
methods.description: Returns a reference to the tensor base from a tensor.

methods.name: __dispatch_contiguous
methods.description: Dispatches a call to make the tensor contiguous with specified memory format.

methods.name: fill_
methods.description: Fills the tensor with a scalar value.

methods.name: zero_
methods.description: Zeros out the tensor.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Converts tensor to specified options.

methods.name: enforce_invariants
methods.description: Checks tensor invariants and consistency.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints tensor information to standard error.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the tensor.

methods.name: variable_data
methods.description: Returns the variable data of the tensor.

methods.name: tensor_data
methods.description: Returns the tensor data.

methods.name: is_leaf
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a leaf node in autograd.

methods.name: output_nr
methods.description: Returns the output number of the tensor.

methods.name: set_data
methods.description: Sets new data for the tensor.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the data of the tensor.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Returns the version of the tensor.

methods.name: retain_grad
methods.description: Retains gradient for the tensor.

methods.name: retains_grad
methods.description: Checks if the tensor retains gradient.

methods.name: _backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass on the tensor.

methods.name: requires_grad_
methods.description: Sets whether the tensor requires gradient.

methods.name: is_view
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a view.

methods.name: _base
methods.description: Returns the base tensor if this is a view.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the tensor.

methods.name: grad_fn
methods.description: Returns the gradient function node.

methods.name: remove_hook
methods.description: Removes a hook at a specified position.

methods.name: _register_hook
methods.description: Registers a new hook.

methods.name: grad_dtype
methods.description: Returns the gradient dtype.

methods.name: set_grad_dtype
methods.description: Sets the gradient dtype.
